findings.title: Federated rules are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: The previous ability check detected federated groups through `source_tenants` and disabled editing and deletion for their rules. This refactor hard-codes `isFederated` to `false`, so federated rules can now appear editable or deletable whenever the user has the corresponding permissions. Attempts to mutate these rules can fail or violate the federated-rule restrictions; preserve the group’s federated status in the ability check.

findings.title: Silence action does nothing for Prometheus-only Grafana rules
findings.body: The new Grafana list item supplies `promRule` without a `rule`, so `showSilenceDrawer` can become true after selecting Silence but this condition remains false. The menu can therefore offer Silence based on Prom-rule abilities, yet clicking it never renders the drawer or creates a silence. Render the drawer using the Prom rule path or avoid offering the action when it cannot be handled.

findings.title: Pause is unavailable for Prometheus-only Grafana rules
findings.body: The new list path supplies only `promRule`, but this menu item is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. Consequently, even when the Prom-rule ability check says pausing is supported and allowed, the Pause item is never rendered. Adapt the pause action to the Prom rule data or otherwise retain the required ruler data for this operation.

findings.title: Delete is hidden for Prometheus-only Grafana rules
findings.body: The new list path does not provide `rulerRule`, so this `rulerRule` guard hides Delete even when `canDelete` is true from the Prom-rule ability check. Users viewing these rules in the list cannot delete them, although the action identifier and delete handler can be built from the Prom rule.

findings.title: The rule detail link drops the return-to location
findings.body: The previous Grafana rule loader included a `returnTo` URL when linking from the alert list to rule details. This replacement link omits it, so navigating back from a rule opened in the list may lose the user’s list/filter context. Preserve the return-to location when constructing the detail URL.
